verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's evidence is entirely about mobile/web subscription entitlements, paywalls, offerings, and analytics — there is no mention of tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing models, usage-based billing, credits, commitments, or overage handling. This is a fundamentally different pricing model (fixed subscription products/entitlements) than usage-metering billing constructs finance leads need for hybrid subscription-plus-usage.
